remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. On verso is acid transfer of a lost skull drawing. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1918. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "4/13/67 – O'K says not done in 1918. Probably same year as 'Red Hill and White Shell,' 1938, ptg." Dated 1934 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A spiral shell sits at the center of the composition. The shell has a smooth, gray surface with a few ripples and a black center. Exposed white paper surrounds the shell on all sides.
